title: Censoring, Survival & Hazard Functions
interviewAnswer: Survival analysis models time until an event while handling censored observations whose event time is not fully observed. Survival S(t) is probability of surviving past t; hazard describes instantaneous event rate conditional on survival.
keyPoints: Do not treat censored durations as completed outcomes.
Hazard and survival encode related but different views.
why: Censoring, Survival & Hazard Functions appears frequently in data-science work because it connects mathematical assumptions to practical decisions, diagnostics and failure modes.

A strong practitioner separates the modeling assumption from the estimation procedure, checks diagnostics rather than trusting a single score, and explains what would make the method inappropriate.
workedExample: Customers still active at dataset cutoff provide partial churn-time information and should not be labeled as “never churn.”
